Good afternoon Loz,

I hope this message finds you well. I tried to reach you by phone earlier today but was unable to connect.

I am writing to confirm that a 20% refund of £30.99 was processed to your bank account on 02.10.2025. The Acquirer Reference Number (ARN) for this transaction is: 74208475276100096508449

Regarding your quality concern, we would appreciate your assistance in providing the following information so we can investigate further with the pharmacy or manufacturer:

- Product name and strength (e.g. Releaf GK-T21 10g)
- Batch number (usually found on the packaging label)
- Expiry date
- Order number or prescription reference
- A brief description of the issue you have noticed
- Any photos showing the packaging or product

If you would like to proceed with a discharge from the clinic, please let me know and I will be happy to assist you with this process.

Warmest Regards,

Natasha Long
Patient Support & Dissatisfaction Coordinator

I would like to launch a official complaint for the quality of the last two packages for the quality of the apple gelato my last package and for promising a refund on the package several months ago that wasn't handled and ignored even though I was answered by email, the content did not deal with the issue I also would like to leave

Hi Big Narstie Medical Team,

I am currently with Releaf, and they do not have any medical documents
available on their portal. The document I previously provided was sent by
my GP specifically in response to my request for a Summary of Care.
Additionally, when I first submitted this document, your website's
verification system approved it, so I am unclear as to why it is now being
rejected.

My GP's office is currently facing long wait times, and there is an
additional administration charge to request further documentation. Given
these constraints, what alternative options are available to move forward
with my application? I can provide screenshots of my Releaf login if that
would help verify my current treatment and medical history.

Best regards,

Loz Turner

Dear Releaf Support Team,

Please accept my sincerest apologies, as I provided incorrect information in my previous email regarding my account. I am incredibly sorry for the confusion and any inconvenience this has caused.

The situation is actually the opposite of what I described. My advocate, Natasha, successfully and intentionally signed me up for the "Relief" subscription using her bank details. This was the correct and desired choice. The mistake was my claim that I should have been on the Pay As You Go plan.

Please disregard my previous request for a refund. I am very happy with the subscription and wish for the payment to stand as processed.

Thank you for your understanding, and I apologize again for this error.

Kind regards,

Loz Turner

Full email body
Dear Releaf Support Team,

I am writing to raise a serious concern about my recent consultation and the ongoing pattern of errors affecting my care.

During my consultation on 3rd January 2026, I specifically discussed increasing my vape cartridge prescription so I could purchase the £199 850mg vape. The clinician AGREED with me and APPROVED this increase. This should be reflected in the consultation notes.

The proof that this conversation took place is that the vape product is now on my CHOSEN prescription list - not the outside list. This clearly demonstrates that the discussion happened and approval was given. Yet despite this, my vape cartridge allowance was not actually increased to allow me to order it.

This is now the FOURTH consultation where things have not gone to plan. I do not understand how the wires keep getting crossed between what is discussed and agreed in consultations versus what actually gets actioned on my account.

To make matters worse, because the Relief subscription was paid (in error - see separate email), my plan does not allow me to book another consultation to fix this. I am now being told I would have to pay £100 for another consultation just to correct YOUR error - an error where the clinician agreed and approved something that simply wasn't processed.

This is completely unacceptable. I should not have to pay £100 to fix a mistake that was not mine.

WHAT I NEED:
1. The vape cartridge prescription increase to be actioned immediately - as was agreed and approved in my January consultation
2. A review of why this keeps happening - this is the 4th consultation with issues
3. If a consultation is needed to fix this, it should be provided free of charge as this is your error, not mine
4. All outstanding refunds/credits from previous issues to be processed

The evidence is on my account - the product is on my chosen list, proving the discussion took place. Please action this urgently.

Kind regards,
Loz Turner
lozturner@gmail.com

Dear Releaf Support Team,

I am writing regarding a payment error that occurred on my account.

My friend and advocate, Natasha, assists me with paperwork and administrative tasks on my behalf. She recently logged into my Releaf account to help process my prescription payment. However, she accidentally selected the wrong payment option - the "Relief" subscription - when this was not the intended choice. She used her own bank details to make the payment.

This was a genuine mistake. I did not want or need the Relief subscription. I should have been on the standard Pay As You Go plan.

I would like to request a refund for the difference between the Relief subscription and the standard Pay As You Go payment. Please note the refund should go back to Natasha's bank details as she made the payment on my behalf.

Please confirm this can be actioned urgently.

Kind regards,
Loz Turner
lozturner@gmail.com

Good afternoon, Loz.

Thank you for your email.

I apologise for any frustration or confusion this may have caused. I can confirm that my colleague called you on the 20th December to discuss this change but they were unfortunately unable to reach you.

In regards to your prescription (#263476410), I can confirm that we have received your payment and your prescription is currently being dispensed by our pharmacy. This should arrive before Christmas.

I can also confirm that the aforementioned partial refund (£30.99) for prescription #111150762 was actioned by Releaf. If you have not received this refund, please quote ARN number 74208475276100096508449 directly with your bank. Please note, an ARN number can only be provided once the refund has been processed.

Should you have any further queries, or if we can be of any further assistance please do not hesitate to contact us, as we are happy to help you in any way we can.

Warmest Regards,

We’d love to hear your feedback

Full email body
Dear Releaf Support team,

I am writing regarding my appointment today, 18th December 2025, at 14:45.

I logged into my account in good time for the consultation, but I
experienced significant technical difficulties throughout. The system
allowed me to log in, however the call repeatedly disconnected and I
suspect my internet connection was not stable enough to maintain the video
call. Despite doing my best to join and stay connected, I was ultimately
unable to attend the appointment properly because of these issues.

I sincerely apologise for any inconvenience this has caused. As the
problems were technical and largely beyond my control, I would be very
grateful if you could consider waiving any missed or late appointment fee
on this occasion.

This appointment is really important to me, as I urgently need to:

-

Discuss being upgraded to vapes,
-

Talk about a possible allergy or adverse reaction to one of the strains
I have been prescribed, and
-

Follow up on refunds/credits that I understand are still outstanding and
have not yet been processed.

Could you please let me know what the next steps are and how I can
reschedule as soon as possible? I am very keen to get another appointment
booked and to resolve these issues promptly.

Thank you very much for your time and understanding.

Kind regards,
Loz Turner

Dear Loz,

I hope this email finds you well,

I am reaching out to you as it has been bought to our attention that you are dissatisfied with the service provided. I am sorry to hear this and will aim to get the issues resolved for you.

I can see there is a note regarding a refund. I can confirm on the 02/10 a partial refund of £30.99 was processed for you. If you have not received this refund, please quote the ARN number directly with your bank. ARN number - 74208475276100096508449

I believe the other issue is surrounding stock, we understand how frustrating it is when your medication is out of stock and we truly understand the importance of your medication. If your preferred medication is out of stock, our clinical team can issue a suitable alternative to the out of stock medication. Please do let me know if this has not been the case and I will raise this with our clinical team for you.

Please do let me know if there is anything else I can support you with.

Should you have any further queries, or if we can be of any further assistance please do not hesitate to contact us, as we are happy to help you in any way we can.

Good Afternoon Loz,

Thank you for your email.

We deeply apologise for the delay in communication, and truly hope we can resolve this with you.

I can confirm that your prescription order has now been shipped, you will receive a separate email containing the tracking details of this order.

I can also confirm that a 20% refund has been actioned for this prescription.

You will receive a separate e-mail confirmation containing the refund receipt once this has been completed. It can vary depending on your financial institution as to the time it will take for funds to be credited back to your account. We anticipate that it may take between 5 to 10 business days for the refund to be processed.

We would like to offer you one month of Releaf+ free as charge, as a further apology for the delay of your prescription. If you wish to accept this, please do let me know.

Once again, I deeply apologise for the experience you have had during this time, and do truly hope we can resolve this with you.

Should you have any further queries, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Warmest Regards,

Hi Emily,

I'd like to first start with why I've not received a reply? You messaged me
on Thursday and said you marked it as urgent. I actually had to later call
your service that same day while I was in hospital A&E for the very
symptoms I'm supposed to be receiving your medication for. Both your
colleague on the phone and yourself have mentioned urgent as has been
marked on my order.

If any more time passes from the time of this email, I would have received
the product within normal time constraints, except it would've been an
additional 4-5 business days. Totalling 10 or more business days, which is
more realistically from my point-of-view nearer to 18 days with weekends
included, nothing urgent about that!

I find it odd professionally and annoying personally to email somebody and
then say we don't know the reason. I have paid for a service/product not
just as a patient but as a customer and then had no follow-up.

There are other issues with the way one of my consults was conducted, an
error in administration and re-booking to the follow-up consultation. Then
the remedy (which i was grateful for ) via a refund for the Plus+
Subscription and how that also is incomplete.

So the issues are mounting across multiple areas: 1. Regarding my
second-to-last consultation, in how it was conducted. 2. the last
consultation and the error in booking and the additional days I had to wait
due to your consultant's availability(the positive was the end result got
me back to having a prescription). 3. Then this last order, and trying to
find an update for it. The fact that nobody knows what's going on. 4. Your
colleague detailed that on this occasion it was due to the pharmacist or
someone not writing a script, but the fact that I had to wait a second "4-5
days waiting window makes no sense to me". 5. I have been compensated, I
believe by way of Plus+ subscribtion refund but even that doesn't make
sense as I was refunded £30 for a prescription that is £39.99?

I need you to supply to me the official complaints procedure either by
link, form or email.

next actions points are:
At this point, I want the details - not just an explanation for where my
script is going to be coming. An ETA when it will be arriving at my door
with a tracking number please, if you'd be so kind.
Also, a complaints procedure (either email or link to a website) so I can
follow to the letter formally.

*Summary for Quick Reference*

-

*No Reply:* I am asking why I haven't received a reply since your last
message on Thursday, especially since the order was marked as *urgent*.
-

*Urgent Order is Slow:* I had to call the service while in A&E for
symptoms the medication is meant to treat. The delivery time is now
expected to be *10+ business days* (around 18 calendar days total),
which is *not urgent*.
-

*Lack of Follow-up:* I am frustrated that your service can't explain why
my paid order is delayed.
-

*Other Problems:* I have past issues I want to formally address: a
poorly conducted consultation, an administration error, and an *incomplete
refund* (£30 refunded for a £39.99 prescription).
-

*Immediate Action Needed:*
-

*ETA & Tracking:* I need a *specific estimated time of arrival (ETA)*
and a *tracking number* for the current medication order.
-

*Complaints Procedure:* I need the *official complaints procedure*
(link, form, or email details) so I can file a formal complaint.

Thank you in advance
Mr. Turner

Good evening Leah,

Thank you for your email and for the thoughtful gesture of sending a
replacement battery. I truly appreciate you taking the initiative to
address my recent concerns.

However, I must admit that I am still somewhat unhappy about the core issue
that led to my initial frustration, which was the inability to fully
utilize the product in the cartridge. While the replacement battery is a
kind offer, it doesn't directly resolve the problem of product wastage or
the faulty vape cartridge. I've also purchased this from you as a retailer
and would like to return it. The battery is 'Releaf' while the vape
cartridge is 'CuraLeaf'. I would like a postal address to return it to you
so you can see the damage for yourself. Additionally, looking back through
your email, it appears you have missed most of the image attachments
showing the damage to the vape cartridge, as I outlined previously. My
primary concern remains the significant amount of unusable product left in
the cartridge, which I estimate to be between 0.1g and 0.2g, representing a
considerable financial loss given the product's cost. I am still looking
for a solution or an explanation as to why this occur, after I followed the
last support emails advice. and how to mitigate it in the future.

Thank you again for your efforts and understanding.

Warmest Regards,
Loz

Good Morning Loz,

Thank you for your email.

Thank you for sharing the additional images regarding your concerns with the vape cartridge.

In reference to the remaining drop of oil residue, it’s worth noting that a small amount will typically remain due to the natural consistency of the oil.

Upon closer inspection, it appears that external heat may have been applied to the outside of the cartridge, which has caused visible bubbling on the glass.

As a gesture of goodwill, we’d be happy to offer you a replacement on this occasion. However, please be aware that we will not be able to provide further replacements should the same issue arise again.

If you have any further questions, please let me know.

Warmest regards,

replacement battery. I truly appreciate you taking the initiative to

that led to my initial frustration, which was the inability to fully
utilize the product in the cartridge. While the replacement battery is a
kind offer, it doesn't directly resolve the problem of product wastage or
the faulty vape cartridge. I've also purchased this from you as a retailer
and would like to return it. The battery is 'Releaf' while the vape
cartridge is 'CuraLeaf'. I would like a postal address to return it to you
so you can see the damage for yourself. Additionally, looking back through
your email, it appears you have missed most of the image attachments
showing the damage to the vape cartridge, as I outlined previously. My
primary concern remains the significant amount of unusable product left in
the cartridge, which I estimate to be between 0.1g and 0.2g, representing a
considerable financial loss given the product's cost. I am still looking
for a solution or an explanation as to why this occur, after I followed the
last support emails advice. and how to mitigate it in the future.

initially shipped remains in the cartridge , I estimate 0.1g - 0.2g
(the product
shipped with 0.5g).
I am unable to vaporise this leftover liquid as it won't wick through to
the cotton and tastes like burning. While some residue is common in typical
vaping products (nicotine vapes etc), I would like to understand how I can
access the remaining product, which amounts to at least £30 of product
unused based from the cost. I am quite disappointed with the form factor
and the delivery of the product, even with the preheat function. I would
appreciate it if someone could explain whether I've missed some
information, if I haven't used it properly, if it's a faulty item, or if
the mechanism itself is not well thought out. This was a significant
investment for me, and I hope you understand my concerns.

Finally, for the first time, I'm frustrated regarding the ongoing issues
with your customer service. I initially sent an email last week and then
called earlier this week, leaving a message for a callback (which your
automated service offered), which I did not receive. When I called again
yesterday, I was asked to resend the email. As I did have the ability to
attach pictures in my previous email but not write, I have now resent this,
as I instructed on the last call.

Mr. L. Turner
